env.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

metric.name: next-token refusal log-odds
metric.note: Arditi-compatible efficient proxy. IDs are derived from refusal phrases using each newer model's tokenizer rather than copied from older models.

interpretation.global: candidate direction is removed from every block input and every attention/MLP write, matching Arditi's released all-write ablation
interpretation.local: candidate direction is removed only at its source layer, across all sequence positions
interpretation.addition: the unnormalized difference-in-means magnitude is added at its source layer
interpretation.controls: matched random controls are reserved for full-generation validation at selected sites
